verdict.rationale:
React's docs describe state updates triggering targeted re-renders ('React will update the screen to match the new data') and the React Compiler explicitly auto-optimizes re-renders by eliminating manual useMemo/useCallback/React.memo, ensuring only dependent UI updates (react-docs-3, react-docs-15, react-docs-17). Incremental adoption and debugging guides show this is a mature, real feature (react-docs-16, react-docs-18).

missing for 10: dedicated useState/useReducer hook docs explicitly framing 'reactive state', independent benchmarks confirming re-render scoping precision.
